dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: This is a key site of the Kanjou Commission, not a place an outlander such as yourself should visit.

dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: If you wish to seek audience with the Kanjou Commissioner, then you should go to the Outlander Affairs Agency and hand in your letter and name card.

dialogues.speaker: Yokoyama
dialogues.text: As for whether you can see the Commissioner... I'd say it's up to luck.
